chunks: The Imami religion is the affirmation of the oneness of Allah, exalted be His mention, and the negation of anthropomorphism (tashbih) from Him, and His exclusion from what is not suitable for Him. And the affirmation of the prophets of Allah, His messengers, His Proofs, His angels, and His books.

And the affirmation that Muhammad (peace be upon him and his family) is the master of the prophets and the messengers, and that he is superior to them and to all the Angels of Proximity, and that he is the Seal of the Prophets, so there is no prophet after him until the Day of Resurrection.

And that all the prophets, messengers, and Imams (peace be upon them) are superior to the angels, and that they are infallible and purified from every uncleanliness and filth; they do not consider committing a sin, neither minor nor major, nor do they commit it. And that they are a safeguard for the people of the earth, just as the stars are a safeguard for the people of the heavens.

key_terms.الإمامية: The Imamiyyah: the Twelver Shia school of thought that believes in the twelve Imams as successors of the Prophet
key_terms.التشبيه: Tashbih: anthropomorphism, the attribution of human-like qualities to God, which is rejected in Islamic theology
key_terms.خاتم النبيين: Khatam al-Nabiyyin: Seal of the Prophets, a Quranic title for Prophet Muhammad indicating the finality of prophethood
key_terms.معصومون: Ma'sumin: infallible, divinely protected from sin and error

ai.seo_question: What are the core beliefs of the Imami (Twelver Shia) religion?
ai.summary: Shaykh al-Saduq (d. 381 AH) dictated this creedal statement to the Shia community of Nishapur during a Friday assembly in 368 AH, outlining the foundational beliefs of the Imami (Twelver Shia) school. It covers divine oneness (tawhid), rejection of anthropomorphism (tashbih), belief in prophets and divine figures, the supremacy and finality of Prophet Muhammad, the superiority of prophets and Imams over angels, and the doctrine of infallibility (ismah) of the prophets and Imams.

en.bilal-muhammad: On this day, the people of his assembly and the elders convened to the Shaykh al-Faqih, Abu Ja`far Muhammad b. `Ali b. al-Husayn b. Musa b. Babuwayh al-Qummi (ra), and they asked him to dictate to them and describe the Imami religion with conciseness and summarization. So, he (ra) said: The Imami religion is the affirmation of the oneness of Allah, exalted be His mention, and the negation of similarity (tashbih) [to His creation] for Him, and His exclusion from what is not suitable for Him. It is the affirmation of the prophets of Allah, His messengers, His Proofs, His angels, and His books.

It is the affirmation that Muhammad (s) is the master of the prophets, and that he is superior to them, and [superior to] all the Angels of Proximity, and that he is the Seal of Prophets. There is no prophet after him until the Day of the Resurrection.

All the prophets, messengers, and Imams (as) are superior to the angels. They are immaculate (ma`sumin) and purified from every uncleanliness and filth. They do not consider doing neither the minor sin nor the major, nor do they commit it, and they are a safeguard for the people of the Earth just as the stars are a safeguard for the people of heaven.
